review: The staff explained every option clearly and made buying my first car easy.
The salesperson was friendly and answered all my questions.
The car was clean and the test drive was a great experience.
They fixed the small issue quickly and kept me updated.
The service team was helpful and finished the inspection early.
I love the car, but the paperwork took much longer than expected.
Nobody returned my call and I waited an hour after my appointment.
The quoted price changed when I arrived at the dealership.
The repair was not completed and I had to book another appointment.
The staff were dismissive when I asked about the warranty.
There was a scratch on delivery that had not been mentioned.
The service appointment ran late and no one explained the delay.
